name: overlappingObjects
meaning: CountAndCapture passes this address as the ObjGrid_QueryBoxPoints output (0x4aec35-46); indexed pointer load at 0x4aec92. Eight entries, inferred from the next field at 0x84.

name: overlapCount
meaning: the query result from EAX, stored at 0x4aec51; signed count comparison at 0x4aec5a-61 and signed loop bound at 0x4aec80-86.

name: pushDelta
meaning: Init's word stores at 0x4ae871/7d/89 set (0,10,0); PushObjectsDown passes its address to ScnObject::Translate.

name: unusedOffset
meaning: Init stores (0,-30,0) into it (word stores at 0x4ae895/a1/ad). Its purpose is not established; the name is a placeholder.

name: triggerBox
meaning: thiscall receiver at 0x4ae7c7 for Box_Translate 0x5154ce; the min words at 0x98/9a/9c and max at 0x9e/a0/a2 are translated at 0x4ae7d9-867. flags + min + max: a complete CollBox.

name: state
meaning: SetState 0x4aea32 compares its byte argument with the field and stores it; Update switches on this byte.

name: victim
meaning: cleared at 0x4ae76c; stored at 0x4aed16, then the receiver of a virtual message at 0x4aed27-3a.

name: captureActive
meaning: cleared at 0x4ae779; a DWORD 1 is stored at 0x4aed40; SetState case 2 compares it with 1.
